listings.thesis: public outsourced semiconductor assembly/test provider added because AMD filings identify the ATMP joint ventures with Tongfu; upside linked to AMD compute demand and packaging/test capacity.

priorCase.rankRationale: Tongfu Microelectronics should move up because HBM/chiplet advanced packaging and OSAT capacity is more directly connected to the 2027 AI compute bottleneck than its current rank 26 implies, with current company-specific evidence; 57.5% YTD and $15.0B market cap do not fully offset the catalyst.
